description: µWeave is a Python-based document description language for interactive worksheets: one source for PDF, HTML and an integrated AI learning coach.
tagline: AI-assisted creation of interactive, accessible worksheets – with a consistent look and feel and a natively integrated AI learning coach.
definition_body: A .muweave file, such as document.muweave, is an ordinary text file that describes a document’s content without prescribing its precise appearance or layout. The same source produces print-ready PDFs, interactive worksheets with an integrated AI learning coach and structured content for AI models. All outputs share one source.
html_title: Interactive worksheet with an integrated AI learning coach
html_detail: Interactive elements and answer fields in the browser.
python_title: Python as part of the document
python_focus: µWeave aims for maximum productivity, flexibility and expressive power, together with a consistent presentation. µWeave therefore builds on the widely used programming language Python instead of developing a language of its own. Many AI models have extensive training on Python code and can put their programming capabilities to full use in creating documents.
python_body: Core principle: Arbitrary Python expressions can appear in µWeave source. A preceding µ makes them recognisable to the parser. µWeave evaluates the expressions and replaces them with their results in the finished document.
workflow_body: An AI-assisted editor is recommended for creating and revising µWeave documents. AI handles the tedious details of the source code, leaving more time for the content and teaching approach.
code_label: A small glimpse of the source
code_caption: The Python value is inserted directly into the formula. The same source supplies the formula for every output.
coach_title: A learning coach that knows the teaching material
coach_body: The AI learning coach supports learners directly in the HTML worksheet. With every request, it automatically receives the worksheet content and the conversation so far in a form prepared for AI. This lets it tailor its guidance precisely to the teaching material and the notation and terminology used in it.
coach_author: Preliminary instructions from the authors, or a pre-prompt, guide how the coach helps: for example, the language level, the kinds of hints it provides and how it handles solutions. These instructions accompany every prompt too.
guidance_quote: Always use exactly the same terms and symbols as in the worksheet. Start by offering a hint. Ask about the learner’s approach before explaining the next step towards the solution.
coach_caption: From a German-language HTML worksheet on velocity: teaching material on the left, the learning coach on the right.
math_body: Screen readers can read mathematical formulas aloud alongside the text. The worksheet includes formulas as native MathML, keeping fractions, roots and indices accessible as mathematical structures.

start_body: The downloadable example source provides a starting point for new material. AI can help adapt tasks, values and explanations to a class. The teacher reviews the content before the required output is generated.
start_prompt: This µWeave worksheet needs adapting for a class. Learners should make a prediction first, then check it using the graph. Two additional tasks and hints should encourage further thinking.

language_page_title: What is a document description language? · µWeave
language_description: A plain-language explanation of how a text file describes a worksheet’s content and structure, and how µWeave produces PDF, interactive HTML and AI context from it.
language_title: What is a document description language?
language_intro: Markdown and LaTeX illustrate the principle: a short source text describes the content and its structure. Each of the following excerpts contains a heading and a sentence with only one word in bold.
language_structure_body: Markers and commands identify parts such as headings, formulas and tasks. The design gives similar elements a consistent appearance. This allows content and design to be edited separately.
language_example_body: In this example, Python sets the value of a to 2. The formula marked with µm uses that value. µWeave turns it into the mathematical formula shown here. The source remains an editable text file.
language_outputs_body: µWeave uses the same source for a printable PDF, an interactive worksheet in the browser and subject context for the AI learning coach. Content changes appear in the regenerated outputs. Interactive elements respond in the browser; the PDF shows their initial values.
language_python_body: The description can contain Python calculations. These can calculate values, vary tasks, insert recurring content and describe interactive graphics. The source can be written and adapted by hand or with AI assistance.
language_definition: A document description language records what a document should contain and how it is structured in a text file. A renderer (for Markdown) or compiler (for LaTeX) reads that description and produces the finished document, such as a web page or a PDF.
language_markdown_caption: In Markdown, # marks a heading. Two asterisks on either side of text mark strong emphasis, usually displayed in bold.
language_latex_caption: In LaTeX, \section* creates an unnumbered heading. \textbf sets the text inside the braces in bold. This is an excerpt from the document body.
bold_call:
The values are a = µa and b = µb.
Their product is µexpr(a * b).
The list µstr(values) has the sum µsum(values).
The combined result of the product and the sum is µbold(str(result)).
